author: Inside Edition
description: This cow in Austria doesn't need to wait around for a human to scratch an annoying itch. Veronika is a 13-year-old Swiss Brown and has figured out how to fashion a broom into a back scratcher. Her owners say she's been doing this for nine years and has become a pro. They say she started out using tree branches. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Cow Uses Broom To Scratch Her Own Back In Austria

author: Inside Edition
description: In January 2024, Victoria Beckham posted a video celebrating her daughter-in-law Nicola Peltz's birthday. Little did many know that behind the scenes, there was family drama. Brooklyn Beckham claimed two years earlier, his mom "hijacked" his wedding and danced "very inappropriately" on him. Brooklyn's six-page post hit a nerve across the country. Women across social media are sharing horror stories about the women they call their monster-in-laws.
title: Women Share Wedding Horror Stories After Brooklyn Beckham's Post

author: Inside Edition
description: It is bitter cold outside in many parts of the US, and it's going to get worse before it gets better. The next arctic blast will be felt in large swaths of the country. The storm is expected to include heavy snow and damaging ice. There are some new high tech tools that can help you stay warm in the deep freeze. Inside Edition's Steven Fabian went to Paragon Sports in New York City to get outfitted in the latest high-tech gear.
title: High Tech Gear That Can Help You Stay Warm In Deep Freeze

author: Inside Edition
description: Wade Wilson, who has dozens of tattoos on his face, became known as the "Deadpool Killer," because he shared the name of the Marvel character. Some jurors were so scared of his looks they had to be excused, but he has attracted a cult following of thousands of women. Wilson murdered two women, Kristine Melton and Diane Ruiz, in Florida during a drug fueled spree in 2019. Wilson's story is being told in the new documentary series "Handsome Devil: Charming Killer" streaming on Paramount Plus.
title: New Documentary Tells Story Of The 'Handsome Devil'

author: Inside Edition
description: Elizabeth Smart was 14 in 2002 when she was abducted from her bedroom. The search for Smart made headlines across the nation for nine agonizing months before she was found alive. Now, Smart is the subject of the new Netflix documentary "Kidnapped: Elizabeth Smart." Her abductor was Brian David Mitchell. His wife, Wanda Barzee was involved in the crime. Inside Edition spoke to the director and producer behind the documentary, Benedict Sanderson and Claire Goodlass.
title: Kidnap Survivor Elizabeth Smart Subject Of New Netflix Documentary

author: Inside Edition
description: President Donald Trump has ruled out going to war over Greenland. Trump bashed Europe's leaders in an hour-long speech at the World Economic Forum in Davos and made it clear that he wants Greenland and will not take no for an answer. Trump also confused Greenland for Iceland four times. There was drama Tuesday night with Air Force One that delayed the US president's arrival in Switzerland. The plane was forced to turn back an hour into the flight because of an "electrical issue."
title: What Happened On Air Force One?

author: Inside Edition
description: Melissa Gilbert spoke out after a judge ordered her husband, Timothy Busfield, to be released on his own recognizance. The "Little House On The Prairie" actress said she has also faced backlash. She tells Inside Edition's Jim Moret that she had only been able to speak to her husband by phone since his arrest eight days ago. Police allege Busfield "engaged in unlawful sexual conduct with twin brothers" on the set of the TV show "The Cleaning Lady." He denies the allegations.
title: Melissa Gilbert Speaks Out After Timothy Busfield Released From Jail

title: Who Shot Indiana Judge And His Wife? #shorts
